prayerExcerpt.en-US: O God, who are rich in mercy

meta.face: A sturdy, broad-shouldered, athletic man of about sixty, clean-shaven, with a broad Slavic face, high cheekbones and a strong square jaw, light grey-blue eyes, fair, greying ash-blond hair showing at the temples under the zucchetto, and a warm, open half-smile; not heavy or fleshy.
meta.basis: Photographs from his first decade as pope (1979 Poland, 1991) and the record of an athlete and mountaineer elected at 58; the Scorzelli ferula he carried everywhere. Kept lean and fair to stand apart from Leo's heavy, dark-eyed pope.
